name: leporine-masque-costs-one-less-per-omen
notes: Leporine Masque: (6), banish: draw a card into memory, costing one less per omen: with two omens it takes four reserve payments. The (6) used to be free.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Leporine Masque's "(6), Banish Leporine Masque" cost was never paid: ActivatedAbilityCost() had no entry for it (or only banished the card), so the ability was free. Fix: ActivatedAbilityCost() banishes the card and queues the reserve payments.
